criteria.criterion: vloop brief close takes name or path; refusals print one stderr line, nothing on stdout, write/stage/commit nothing (all six messages and exit codes)
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/close.go: closeFindingsMsg check (exit 2), then no runs, already consumed/abandoned, default-branch, dirty tree (--untracked-files=all), plan not complete, all before any write. TestCloseRefusals asserts stdout empty, stderr exact, HEAD/status unchanged and no .vloop/defects.

criteria.criterion: Each --finding becomes a defect file via the same code as defect add (brief, operator, work, bug, medium, open)
criteria.evidence: close.go calls defect.Add with FoundBy operator, Origin work, Kind bug, Severity medium; no second writer.

criteria.criterion: Metrics computed as vloop metrics with the new status and saved with task 2's snapshot writer; snapshot equals metrics --json after close
criteria.evidence: metrics.Build then report.Status=consumed, closing.WriteSnapshot; gate compares against live metrics --json.

criteria.criterion: Run record via PutRunRecord and renderer; frontmatter status consumed; body Status line rewritten keeping prefix; nothing else changes
criteria.evidence: setFrontmatterStatus edits only the status line; statusLine regexp keeps ${1} prefix and rewrites first occurrence; closing.PutRunRecord(doc, closing.Render(...)). TestCloseRerenderKeepsTextAfterMarkers covers the byte-for-byte case.

criteria.criterion: Commit holds exactly defects, snapshot and brief, staged by path, message '[vloop] close <run id>' + blank + trailer, single-parent, no merge/push/fetch/checkout/ref changes
criteria.evidence: git add -- <files>; git commit -q -m subject -m trailer -- <files>; no other git verbs beyond read-only ones. Committed test checks files, message and trailer.

criteria.criterion: Output lines in order matching the worked example
criteria.evidence: PrintSummary, recorded/wrote/updated per file, 'committed <sha7> subject', 'squash-merge with the trailer: ...'; gate T3 replays this line for line and passed.
close.go JSON encoder struct with those fields, files in written order; TestCloseJSON.

criteria.criterion: Committed TestClose... tests on t.TempDir fixtures with git -C: every refusal plus non-refusal case, re-render preserving hand-written text, commit files/message/trailer
criteria.evidence: close_test.go: TestCloseRefusals (9 refusal cases), TestCloseCommitsFindingsSnapshotAndBrief, TestCloseJSON, TestCloseRerenderKeepsTextAfterMarkers; the success tests are the must-not-refuse cases.

criteria.criterion: README documents brief close, --finding, --no-findings, stays under 200 lines
criteria.evidence: README.md diff adds one table row naming all three; file is 192 lines; go test ./internal/cli passes.

notes: Added metrics.DeriveBrief (internal/metrics/defects.go) so the run record's derived defects match Build's; small, in service of the task and reusable by T5 export. It takes 'plan complete' from the last owned run's outcome. No absolute paths found. The empty-finding refusal (a finding must not be empty) is beyond the spec but harmless.
